build_qacnn_data: build the QACNN dataset by calling the build function from the qacnn build module
get_qacnn_data_path: get the path to the QACNN dataset file for a given datatype using the _path function
create_qacnn_teacher: create a DefaultTeacher instance for the QACNN dataset by passing opt with datatype and datapath
review_defaultteacher_class: review the DefaultTeacher class which extends FbDeprecatedDialogTeacher for the QACNN task
summarize_qacnn_agents: summarize the QACNN agents module which provides a teacher for the CNN QA dataset in ParlAI
